messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Problem with sliderInput display
parts: I am using sliderInput in my shiny application. The min, max and step value of sliderInput is 0,10000,1. It appears that the slider can only stop on certain values, for example 194,205, but cannot stop on any value between 194 and 205. When I use updatesliderinput to update the value to be c(0,200), the slider still shows 205 instead of 200. Can anyone fix this?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Problem with sliderInput display
parts:
There are some known difficulties with the slider, e.g.
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/365
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/301

The numericInput() is more reliable in these cases.

BTW, when the maximum is 10000, does it really matter if the selected
value is 195 or 196?

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 22b20bb346174761
messages.subject: Re: Problem with sliderInput display
parts:
The function of my sliderInput is to select a specific region by column in a heatmap with 10000 columns. Now I am adding another function which enables users to input a precise column interval and zoom in that part of heatmap. Finally if user is satisfied with the precise input, shiny will update the precise interval to the sliderInput values.
For example, a user uses sliderInput to select a rough interval from 0 to around 250, but he wants to be more precise about this interval. Because it is unable to see this part clearly on the whole heatmap with 10000 columns, he uses the zoom in function and input a precise interval from 0 to 200. He is satisfied with this selection and want to update the value to the current sliderInput. But now after updating, the sliderInput shows 205 instead of 200, which causes confusion.
